Subject: Zenlytics POC - success criteria & next steps

Hi Aisha / Ravi —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Per our discovery, I wanted to capture the proposed POC plan and success criteria so we’re aligned before the kickoff. Please review and flag any changes.

Summary of objectives:
- Surface low-latency, high-quality semantic search over Zenlytics’ 12M financial docs (initial subset of 250k)
- Demonstrate 95th-percentile response latency <= 450ms for single-document search under typical load
- Show cost / throughput estimates for scaling to production (batching + caching config)

Proposed success criteria (to be signed off by your team):
1) Relevance: average relevance score (team-rated) >= 4/5 on a 50-sample benchmark set
2) Latency: 95th percentile token latency <= 450ms for top-3 results in test harness
3) Stability: no more than 2 errors/hour during a 72-hour soak test with representative queries
4) Integration: sample lambda + SDK integration demonstrating end-to-end retrieval in your staging account

POC timeline (suggested):
- Week 0 (this week): confirm success criteria, share sample data subset and access mechanics
- Week 1: Redwood engineers provision test environment; ingest sample corpus (~250k docs)
- Week 2: Run benchmark suite; iterate on model/quantization + batching profile
- Week 3: Soak test + writeup + decision meeting

Owners / contacts:
- Zenlytics: Aisha Shah (ML Ops), Ravi Menon (Engineering Manager) — data & staging access
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE) — project manager; Dev Patel (Solutions Eng) — technical lead; Nikhil Sharma (SE) — runtime tuning

Attachments: zenlytics_poc_testplan.xlsx (proposed eval metrics + test harness), short config stub for canary flows.

Ask for you today: please confirm by EOD which datasets you can share and whether your security team requires an NDA or additional paperwork before we provision the staging account. Also pls confirm if the proposed timeline works or if we should shift by a week.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

Best,

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min sync if helpful.

Thanks — adding a few technical clarifications to make the Week 1/2 work from the Redwood side: 

- VPC peering: we can run the ingest and runtime in your staging VPC via a customer-controlled peering setup. We’ll need a point-of-contact and a short window for a security review (usually 48 hours).
- Metrics: the 95p 450ms target is configurable. For clarity: the POC will report both (a) end-to-end latency measured from a sample staging lambda (recommended), and (b) token-level runtime latency. We’ll provide a script to reproduce both measurements.
- Credentials: please provide a read-only IAM role with the S3 manifest strings and (if possible) a small set of temporary STS credentials for the ingestion job. If STS isn’t possible, a pre-signed S3 manifest will work.
- Test harness: attaching the proposed ingest + benchmark config (zenlytics_poc_testplan.xlsx). Dev + Nikhil will own the ingest and initial tuning.

Plan update if we shift start by one week (per Aisha):
- Mon 09 Mar: initial data handoff + security review kickoff
- 10-12 Mar: ingestion and index build (Dev / Nikhil)
- 15-19 Mar: benchmark runs and tuning
- 22 Mar: soak test and decision meeting

Let us know the POC POC contact for infra so we can schedule the peering window.
